boundary_condition_count.nonpositive_normal_shift: 10 incoming u1_minus fields = 4 constraint derivative + 2 physical derivative + 4 gauge data

gh_tt_sbp_sat_boundary_pilot.tt_wave: partial_t^2 h_A - partial_x^2 h_A = 0, A in {+,x}
gh_tt_sbp_sat_boundary_pilot.sat: Pi_dot=-D G-H^-1 e_L*(Pi+G)_L-H^-1 e_R*(Pi-G)_R; G_dot=-D Pi; h_dot=-Pi
gh_tt_sbp_sat_boundary_pilot.semi_discrete_energy: E=1/2 sum_A (Pi_A^T H Pi_A + G_A^T H G_A)
gh_tt_sbp_sat_boundary_pilot.reduction_constraint: D h_A-G_A=0 is invariant under the semidiscrete evolution

gh_full_u1_cpbc_slab_pilot.state: (psi_ab, Pi_ab, Phi_xab), with ten symmetric components per field
gh_full_u1_cpbc_slab_pilot.physical_target: P_P*qdot = P_P*gamma2*(Pi + Phi_n - D_n(psi)) for homogeneous incoming Weyl data
gh_full_u1_cpbc_slab_pilot.pointwise_method: replace the incoming characteristic RHS only at the two endpoints
gh_full_u1_cpbc_slab_pilot.compatible_lift_method: cubic metric-RHS lift with D(delta_psi_dot)=delta_Phi_dot; exploratory and spectrally unstable
gh_full_u1_cpbc_slab_pilot.reduced_wave_method: evolve only (psi,Pi), impose Phi_x=D(psi) algebraically, and use the same projected incoming-u1-minus target; this is a distinct second-order comparator, not full first-order GH
gh_full_u1_cpbc_slab_pilot.boundary_scope: zero shift, fixed flat background, one spatial normal, homogeneous constraint and Weyl data, prescribed gauge-data rate

equation_or_mapping.gh_reduced_wave_boundary_comparator: Second-order algebraic reduced-wave evolution in (psi_ab,Pi_ab), with Phi_xab=D(psi_ab) enforced at every RHS evaluation; incoming u1-minus target is inherited from the 4+2+4 frozen-background GH projector algebra.

gh_reduced_wave_sbp_sat_comparator.state: (h_A,Pi_A), A in {+,x}; G_A=D(h_A) is reconstructed algebraically
gh_reduced_wave_sbp_sat_comparator.energy: E=1/2 sum_A(Pi_A^T H Pi_A+G_A^T H G_A)
gh_reduced_wave_sbp_sat_comparator.relation_to_Rinne_physical_target: for q_A=a_A-gamma2*h_A and homogeneous physical data, q_dot=gamma2*Pi implies a_dot=0; the SAT weakly penalizes a_A, and does not implement the full Rinne CPBC
